meta.note: Each board was opened on the check date. Listings change daily; none of these sites is affiliated with this guide.

boards.name: Public Health CareerMart
boards.scope: The largest general public health board in the US: health departments, hospitals, universities, nonprofits. Search by keyword (epidemiologist, biosurveillance, emergency preparedness).

boards.name: Public Health Jobs
boards.org: Association of Schools and Programs of Public Health (ASPPH)
boards.scope: Positions at schools of public health and public health organizations, including fellowships and internships; good for academic and research roles.

boards.name: APHL Career Center
boards.scope: Laboratory roles at state, local, and federal public health laboratories, plus academic and corporate labs: microbiologists, laboratory scientists, biosafety staff.

boards.name: USAJOBS
boards.scope: Every US federal opening, including CDC, FDA, USDA, and DoD. Search "epidemiologist", "health scientist", "biologist", or "emergency management"; the federal 0601 General Health Science series covers most epidemiologist posts.

boards.name: Careers at WHO
boards.scope: WHO staff posts, internships, and the Junior Professional Officer program, across headquarters, regional offices, and country offices.

boards.name: 80,000 Hours job board
boards.scope: Curated roles at organizations working on global problems; filter by the biosecurity and pandemic preparedness problem area. Strong on research, policy, and philanthropy roles, weaker on clinical and government posts.

boards.name: ReliefWeb Jobs
boards.org: UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs
boards.scope: Humanitarian and emergency response positions worldwide, including outbreak response with NGOs and UN agencies; filter by theme (health) and career category.
